0022600118.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-2, 0-1 at home) are in their third game of the season and have lost two straight, sitting 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West. The Memphis Grizzlies (2-0, on a two-game win streak) are 2nd in the Southwest and 5th in the West, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. In 2025-26 the Kings lost the series 1-3, though they won the most recent meeting 123-114 in Memphis on February 23, 2026. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), while Memphis's Cedric Coward is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and is a game-time decision.
